storyline.real: After the last stops Red Bull tell both drivers to hold position, Webber ahead. Vettel passes Webber on lap 46 anyway and wins by 4.3 s.
storyline.headline: Red Bull hold formation and Webber wins in Sepang

mastery.label: Win on two more stops, one fewer than Vettel made

eras.briefing: Sepang, 2013. The race started wet on intermediates and the track has dried. Vettel started on pole, but Webber leads him by 2.4 s. You run Vettel. Get ahead on strategy, before the team has to settle the order.
